void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool has_text(string[] items, string wanted)
    for item := items[]
        if item == wanted
            return true
    return false

string[] words(string text)
    return [for word := text.split(" ")[] if word != "" then word]

nat power_two(nat exponent)
    nat result := 1
    for: i < exponent
        result *= 2
    return result

nat bit_count(nat number)
    nat result := 0
    remaining := number
    while remaining > 0
        result += remaining % 2
        remaining /= 2
    return result

nat xor_numbers(nat a, nat b)
    first := a
    second := b
    nat bit := 1
    nat result := 0
    while first > 0 or second > 0
        if first % 2 != second % 2
            result += bit
        first /= 2
        second /= 2
        bit *= 2
    return result

string row_pattern(nat row, nat size)
    result := ""
    for: i < size
        result += if row / power_two(size - i - 1) % 2 == 0 then "0" else "1"
    return result

string swap_pattern(string pattern)
    result := ""
    for: i < #pattern
        result += if pattern[i] == "0" then "1" else (if pattern[i] == "1" then "0" else "-")
    return result

string omit_zeros(string pattern)
    result := ""
    for: i < #pattern
        result += if pattern[i] == "0" then "-" else pattern[i]
    return result

nat literal_count(string pattern)
    nat result := 0
    for: i < #pattern
        if pattern[i] != "-"
            result += 1
    return result

string pattern_key(string pattern)
    result := ""
    for: i < #pattern
        result += if pattern[i] == "1" then "0" else (if pattern[i] == "0" then "1" else "2")
    return result

string[] order_patterns(string[] patterns)
    map<string, string> by_key
    for pattern := patterns[]
        .by_key.set(pattern_key(pattern), pattern)
    string[] result := []
    for key := by_key.keys().sorted()[]
        match by_key.get(key)
            string pattern
                result = result.append(pattern)
            none
                void
    return result

bool contains_row(string pattern, string bits)
    for: i < #pattern
        if pattern[i] != "-" and pattern[i] != bits[i]
            return false
    return true

string pattern_text(string pattern, string[] var_list, clause := false)
    string[] literals := []
    for: i < #pattern
        if pattern[i] != "-"
            literals = literals.append((if pattern[i] == "0" then "~" else "") + var_list[i])
    if #literals == 0
        return if clause then "0" else "1"
    return literals.join(if clause then " | " else " & ")

string products_text(string[] patterns, string[] var_list, clauses := false)
    string[] parts := []
    for pattern := patterns[]
        part := pattern_text(pattern, var_list, clauses)
        if clauses and #patterns >= 2 and literal_count(pattern) >= 2
            part = "(" + part + ")"
        parts = parts.append(part)
    return if #parts == 0 then (if clauses then "1" else "0") else parts.join(if clauses then " & " else " | ")

string assignment_text(nat row, string[] var_list)
    bits := row_pattern(row, #var_list)
    string[] parts := []
    for: i < #var_list
        parts = parts.append(var_list[i] + "=" + bits[i])
    return "{{" + parts.join(" ") + "}}"

string yes_no(bool flag)
    return if flag then "yes" else "no"

bool valid_name(string text)
    if text == "" or #text > 8 or not "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(text[0])
        return false
    for: i < #text
        if not "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789".contains(text[i])
            return false
    return true

bool variable_word(string text)
    return #text == 1 and "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".contains(text)

string | none merge_patterns(string a, string b);
string[] tidy_clauses(string[] items);

class FormulaNode(string operation, text := "", nat left := 0, nat right := 0)
class Forest()
    FormulaNode[] nodes := []
    nnf_memo := map<nat, nat>()
    clause_memo := map<nat, string[]>()

    nat .leaf(string text)
        result := #nodes
        nodes = nodes.append(FormulaNode(if text == "0" or text == "1" then "C" else "V", text))
        return result

    nat .unary(nat child)
        result := #nodes
        nodes = nodes.append(FormulaNode("~", left = child))
        return result

    nat .binary(string operation, nat a, nat b)
        result := #nodes
        nodes = nodes.append(FormulaNode(operation, left = a, right = b))
        return result

    nat precedence(nat root)
        operation := nodes[root].operation
        if operation == "<->"
            return 1
        if operation == "->"
            return 2
        if operation == "|"
            return 3
        if operation == "^"
            return 4
        if operation == "&"
            return 5
        return 6

    string notation(nat root)
        item := nodes[root]
        if item.operation == "C" or item.operation == "V"
            return item.text
        string first := notation(item.left)
        if item.operation == "~"
            return "~" + (if precedence(item.left) < 6 then "(" + first + ")" else first)
        string second := notation(item.right)
        if precedence(item.left) < precedence(root) or (item.operation == "->" and nodes[item.left].operation == "->")
            first = "(" + first + ")"
        if precedence(item.right) < precedence(root) or (item.operation != "->" and nodes[item.right].operation == item.operation)
            second = "(" + second + ")"
        return first + " " + item.operation + " " + second

    string[] variables(nat root)
        item := nodes[root]
        if item.operation == "C"
            return []
        if item.operation == "V"
            return [item.text]
        string[] result := variables(item.left)
        if item.operation != "~"
            for name := variables(item.right)[]
                if not has_text(result, name)
                    result = result.append(name)
        return result.sorted()

    nat tree_size(nat root)
        item := nodes[root]
        if item.operation == "C" or item.operation == "V"
            return 1
        return 1 + tree_size(item.left) + (if item.operation == "~" then 0 else tree_size(item.right))

    nat tree_depth(nat root)
        item := nodes[root]
        if item.operation == "C" or item.operation == "V"
            return 1
        nat first := tree_depth(item.left)
        nat second := if item.operation == "~" then 0 else tree_depth(item.right)
        return 1 + (if first > second then first else second)

    bool same_tree(nat a, nat b)
        if a == b
            return true
        first := nodes[a]
        second := nodes[b]
        if first.operation != second.operation or first.text != second.text
            return false
        if first.operation == "C" or first.operation == "V"
            return true
        return same_tree(first.left, second.left) and (first.operation == "~" or same_tree(first.right, second.right))

    bool evaluate(nat root, string[] var_list, nat row)
        item := nodes[root]
        if item.operation == "C"
            return item.text == "1"
        if item.operation == "V"
            for: i < #var_list
                if var_list[i] == item.text
                    return row / power_two(#var_list - i - 1) % 2 == 1
            return false
        bool a := evaluate(item.left, var_list, row)
        if item.operation == "~"
            return not a
        bool b := evaluate(item.right, var_list, row)
        if item.operation == "&"
            return a and b
        if item.operation == "|"
            return a or b
        if item.operation == "^"
            return a != b
        if item.operation == "->"
            return not a or b
        return a == b

    bool[] truth_values(nat root, string[] var_list)
        return [for row := (0:<nat(power_two(#var_list)))[] then evaluate(root, var_list, row)]

    nat .negated(nat root)
        item := nodes[root]
        if item.operation == "C"
            return .leaf(if item.text == "0" then "1" else "0")
        return if item.operation == "~" then item.left else .unary(root)

    nat .combine(string operation, nat a, nat b)
        first := nodes[a]
        second := nodes[b]
        a0 := first.operation == "C" and first.text == "0"
        a1 := first.operation == "C" and first.text == "1"
        b0 := second.operation == "C" and second.text == "0"
        b1 := second.operation == "C" and second.text == "1"
        bool equal := same_tree(a, b)
        complementary := (first.operation == "~" and same_tree(first.left, b)) or (second.operation == "~" and same_tree(a, second.left))
        if operation == "&"
            if a0 or b0
                return .leaf("0")
            if a1
                return b
            if b1 or equal
                return a
            if complementary
                return .leaf("0")
        elif operation == "|"
            if a1 or b1
                return .leaf("1")
            if a0
                return b
            if b0 or equal
                return a
            if complementary
                return .leaf("1")
        elif operation == "^"
            if a0
                return b
            if b0
                return a
            if a1
                return .negated(b)
            if b1
                return .negated(a)
            if equal or complementary
                return .leaf(if equal then "0" else "1")
        elif operation == "->"
            if a0 or b1
                return .leaf("1")
            if a1
                return b
            if b0
                return .negated(a)
            if equal
                return .leaf("1")
            if complementary
                return b
        else
            if a1
                return b
            if b1
                return a
            if a0
                return .negated(b)
            if b0
                return .negated(a)
            if equal or complementary
                return .leaf(if equal then "1" else "0")
        return .binary(operation, a, b)

    nat .simplify(nat root, map<string, bool> assigned)
        item := nodes[root]
        if item.operation == "V"
            match assigned.get(item.text)
                bool value
                    return .leaf(if value then "1" else "0")
                none
                    return root
        if item.operation == "C"
            return root
        nat a := .simplify(item.left, assigned)
        if item.operation == "~"
            return .negated(a)
        nat b := .simplify(item.right, assigned)
        return .combine(item.operation, a, b)

    nat .nnf(nat root, positive := true)
        nat key := root * 2 + (if positive then 1 else 0)
        match nnf_memo.get(key)
            nat saved
                return saved
            none
                void
        item := nodes[root]
        result := root
        if item.operation == "V"
            if not positive
                result = .unary(root)
        elif item.operation == "C"
            if not positive
                result = .leaf(if item.text == "0" then "1" else "0")
        elif item.operation == "~"
            result = .nnf(item.left, not positive)
        elif item.operation == "&" or item.operation == "|"
            operation := item.operation
            if not positive
                operation = if operation == "&" then "|" else "&"
            nat a := .nnf(item.left, positive)
            nat b := .nnf(item.right, positive)
            result = .binary(operation, a, b)
        elif item.operation == "->"
            nat a := .nnf(item.left, not positive)
            nat b := .nnf(item.right, positive)
            result = .binary(if positive then "|" else "&", a, b)
        else
            nat a := .nnf(item.left)
            nat na := .nnf(item.left, false)
            nat b := .nnf(item.right)
            nat nb := .nnf(item.right, false)
            same := (item.operation == "<->") == positive
            nat first := .binary("&", a, if same then b else nb)
            nat second := .binary("&", na, if same then nb else b)
            result = .binary("|", first, second)
        .nnf_memo.set(key, result)
        return result

    nat .dual(nat root)
        item := nodes[root]
        if item.operation == "V"
            return root
        if item.operation == "C"
            return .leaf(if item.text == "0" then "1" else "0")
        nat a := .dual(item.left)
        if item.operation == "~"
            return .unary(a)
        nat b := .dual(item.right)
        if item.operation == "->"
            return .binary("&", .unary(a), b)
        operation := if item.operation == "&" then "|" else (if item.operation == "|" then "&" else (if item.operation == "^" then "<->" else "^"))
        return .binary(operation, a, b)

    void .reset_clauses()
        map<nat, string[]> empty_cache
        clause_memo = empty_cache

    string[] .clauses_of(nat root, string[] var_list)
        match clause_memo.get(root)
            string[] saved
                return saved
            none
                void
        item := nodes[root]
        string[] result := []
        if item.operation == "C"
            if item.text == "0"
                result = ["-" * #var_list]
        elif item.operation == "V" or item.operation == "~"
            name := if item.operation == "V" then item.text else nodes[item.left].text
            pattern := ""
            for variable := var_list[]
                pattern += if variable == name then (if item.operation == "V" then "1" else "0") else "-"
            result = [pattern]
        else
            string[] a := .clauses_of(item.left, var_list)
            string[] b := .clauses_of(item.right, var_list)
            if item.operation == "&"
                result = tidy_clauses(a.concat(b))
            else
                for first := a[]
                    for second := b[]
                        match merge_patterns(first, second)
                            string merged
                                result = result.append(merged)
                            none
                                void
                result = tidy_clauses(result)
        .clause_memo.set(root, result)
        return result

string | none merge_patterns(string a, string b)
    result := ""
    for: i < #a
        if a[i] != "-" and b[i] != "-" and a[i] != b[i]
            return none
        result += if a[i] == "-" then b[i] else a[i]
    return result

bool proper_contains(string a, string b)
    if a == b
        return false
    for: i < #a
        if b[i] != "-" and a[i] != b[i]
            return false
    return true

string[] tidy_clauses(string[] items)
    map<string, bool> unique_patterns
    for item := items[]
        .unique_patterns.set(item, true)
    patterns := unique_patterns.keys()
    string[] result := []
    for pattern := patterns[]
        keep := true
        for other := patterns[]
            if proper_contains(pattern, other)
                keep = false
                break
        if keep
            result = result.append(pattern)
    return result

class Token(string text, nat position)
Token[] | error tokenize(string text, nat start)
    Token[] tokens := []
    nat cursor := 0
    while cursor < #text
        c := text[cursor]
        if c == " "
            cursor += 1
            continue
        finish := cursor + 1
        if cursor + 3 <= #text and text[cursor:<cursor + 3] == "<->"
            finish = cursor + 3
        elif cursor + 2 <= #text and text[cursor:<cursor + 2] == "->"
            finish = cursor + 2
        elif "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(c)
            while finish < #text and "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789".contains(text[finish])
                finish += 1
        elif not "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ01~&^|()".contains(c)
            return error("invalid character '" + c + "' at {start + cursor}")
        tokens = tokens.append(Token(text[cursor:<finish], start + cursor))
        cursor = finish
    return tokens.append(Token("", start + #text))

class Reader(Token[] tokens, map<string, nat> definitions)
    nat cursor := 0

    Token peek()
        return tokens[cursor]

    error problem()
        Token token := peek()
        return if token.text == "" then error("unexpected end of formula at {token.position}") else error("unexpected '" + token.text + "' at {token.position}")

    nat | error .atom(Forest &tree)
        Token token := peek()
        if token.text == "("
            cursor += 1
            nat result := try .read_level(&tree, 0)
            if peek().text != ")"
                return problem()
            cursor += 1
            return result
        if token.text == "0" or token.text == "1" or variable_word(token.text)
            cursor += 1
            return .tree.leaf(token.text)
        if token.text != "" and "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(token.text[0])
            match definitions.get(token.text)
                nat found
                    cursor += 1
                    return found
                none
                    return error("undefined name '" + token.text + "' at {token.position}")
        return problem()

    nat | error .read_level(Forest &tree, nat level)
        if level == 5
            if peek().text == "~"
                cursor += 1
                nat child := try .read_level(&tree, 5)
                return .tree.unary(child)
            return .atom(&tree)
        operations := ["<->", "->", "|", "^", "&"]
        operation := operations[level]
        nat result := try .read_level(&tree, level + 1)
        while peek().text == operation
            cursor += 1
            nat other := try .read_level(&tree, if level == 1 then level else level + 1)
            result = .tree.binary(operation, result, other)
            if level == 1
                break
        return result

    nat | error .parse(Forest &tree)
        nat result := try .read_level(&tree, 0)
        if peek().text != ""
            return problem()
        return result

bool[] anf_coefficients(bool[] values, nat size)
    result := values
    for: i < size
        bit := power_two(i)
        for: row < #result
            if row / bit % 2 == 1
                result[row] = result[row] != result[row - bit]
    return result

class BddNode(nat level, nat low, nat high)
class Diagram()
    BddNode[] nodes := []

    nat .build(bool[] values, nat level := 0)
        if #values == 1
            return if values[0] then 1 else 0
        half := #values / 2
        nat low := .build(values[:<half], level + 1)
        nat high := .build(values[half:], level + 1)
        if low == high
            return low
        for: i < #nodes
            if nodes[i].level == level and nodes[i].low == low and nodes[i].high == high
                return i + 2
        nodes = nodes.append(BddNode(level, low, high))
        return #nodes + 1

class Stage(nat implicants, nat primes)
class Minimum(Stage[] stages, string[] targets, string[] essential, string[] cover)
Minimum minimize(nat[] on, nat[] dc, nat size, swapped := false)
    map<string, bool> initial
    for row := on.concat(dc)[]
        .initial.set(row_pattern(row, size), true)
    stage := initial.keys()
    Stage[] statistics := []
    string[] primes := []
    while true
        map<string, bool> merged
        map<string, bool> combined
        map<string, bool> current
        for pattern := stage[]
            .current.set(pattern, true)
        for pattern := stage[]
            for: i < size
                if pattern[i] == "-"
                    continue
                partner := pattern[:<i] + (if pattern[i] == "0" then "1" else "0") + pattern[i + 1:]
                if current.has(partner)
                    .combined.set(pattern, true)
                    .merged.set(pattern[:<i] + "-" + pattern[i + 1:], true)
        nat count := 0
        for pattern := stage[]
            if not combined.has(pattern)
                primes = primes.append(pattern)
                count += 1
        statistics = statistics.append(Stage(#stage, count))
        if merged.size() == 0
            break
        stage = merged.keys()
    string[] targets := []
    nat[][] coverage := []
    for pattern := order_patterns(primes)[]
        nat[] covered := []
        for: i < #on
            if contains_row(pattern, row_pattern(on[i], size))
                covered = covered.append(i)
        if #covered > 0
            targets = targets.append(pattern)
            coverage = coverage.append(covered)
    essential_flags := [for i := (nat(0):<#targets)[] then false]
    for: i < #on
        nat count := 0
        nat chosen := 0
        for: j < #targets
            for covered := coverage[j][]
                if covered == i
                    count += 1
                    chosen = j
        if count == 1
            essential_flags[chosen] = true
    string[] essential := []
    nat[] optional := []
    covered_initial := [for i := (nat(0):<#on)[] then false]
    for: j < #targets
        if essential_flags[j]
            essential = essential.append(targets[j])
            for covered := coverage[j][]
                covered_initial[covered] = true
        else
            optional = optional.append(j)
    string[] best := []
    string[] best_keys := []
    nat best_literals := 0
    found := false
    for: mask < power_two(#optional)
        candidate := essential
        covered := covered_initial
        for: k < #optional
            if mask / power_two(k) % 2 == 1
                j := optional[k]
                candidate = candidate.append(targets[j])
                for row := coverage[j][]
                    covered[row] = true
        complete := true
        for present := covered[]
            if not present
                complete = false
        if not complete
            continue
        nat count := 0
        for pattern := candidate[]
            count += literal_count(pattern)
        shown := order_patterns([for pattern := candidate[] then (if swapped then swap_pattern(pattern) else pattern)])
        keys := [for pattern := shown[] then pattern_key(pattern)]
        earlier := false
        if found and #candidate == #best and count == best_literals
            for: i < #keys
                if keys[i] != best_keys[i]
                    earlier = [keys[i], best_keys[i]].sorted()[0] == keys[i]
                    break
        if not found or #candidate < #best or (#candidate == #best and (count < best_literals or (count == best_literals and earlier)))
            found = true
            best = order_patterns(candidate)
            best_keys = keys
            best_literals = count
    return Minimum(statistics, targets, essential, best)

class Workbench()
    forest := Forest()
    definitions := map<string, nat>()

    nat | error .parse_formula(string text, nat start)
        tokens := try tokenize(text, start)
        reader := Reader(tokens, definitions)
        return .reader.parse(&forest)

    string[] .assign_definition(string name, nat root)
        action := if definitions.has(name) then "redefined " else "defined "
        .definitions.set(name, root)
        return [action + name + " = " + forest.notation(root)]

    string[] | error .run_command(string line)
        command := line
        argument := ""
        has_argument := false
        match line.find(" ")
            nat position
                command = line[:<position]
                argument = line[position + 1:]
                has_argument = true
            none
                void
        commands := "DEF DEFSUM DEL LIST PRINT TABLE MINTERMS MAXTERMS DNF CNF NNF DUAL ANF SIMPLIFY RESTRICT COFACTOR MINIMIZE MINDC MINPOS KMAP SAT TAUT COUNT EQUIV IMPLIES PROPS BDD CLAUSES DP".split(" ")
        if not has_text(commands, command)
            return error("unknown command " + command)
        if command == "LIST"
            if has_argument
                return error("unexpected argument")
            output := ["names: {definitions.size()}"]
            for name := definitions.keys().sorted()[]
                match definitions.get(name)
                    nat root
                        output = output.append(name + " = " + forest.notation(root))
                    none
                        void
            return output
        if not has_argument
            return error("missing argument")
        if command == "DEL"
            if not valid_name(argument)
                return error("invalid name '" + argument + "'")
            if not definitions.has(argument)
                return error("undefined name '" + argument + "'")
            .definitions.remove(argument)
            return ["deleted " + argument]
        if command == "DEF"
            nat separator := 0
            match argument.find(" ")
                nat position
                    separator = position
                none
                    return error("missing argument")
            name := argument[:<separator]
            if not valid_name(name)
                return error("invalid name '" + name + "'")
            nat root := try .parse_formula(argument[separator + 1:], #name + 6)
            return .assign_definition(name, root)
        if command == "DEFSUM"
            nat separator := 0
            match argument.find(";")
                nat position
                    separator = position
                none
                    return error("missing ';'")
            parts := words(argument[:<separator])
            if #parts == 0
                return error("missing argument")
            name := parts[0]
            if not valid_name(name)
                return error("invalid name '" + name + "'")
            var_list := parts[1:]
            valid := #var_list > 0
            for: i < #var_list
                if not variable_word(var_list[i]) or (i > 0 and var_list[i - 1].codepoints()[0] >= var_list[i].codepoints()[0])
                    valid = false
            if not valid
                return error("bad variable list")
            if #var_list >= 9
                return error("too many variables: {#var_list}")
            nat[] rows := []
            for word := words(argument[separator + 1:])[]
                numeric := true
                for: i < #word
                    if not "0123456789".contains(word[i])
                        numeric = false
                if not numeric or (#word > 1 and word[0] == "0")
                    return error("bad minterm '" + word + "'")
                row := nat(word)
                if row >= power_two(#var_list) or (#rows > 0 and row <= rows[-1])
                    return error("bad minterm '" + word + "'")
                rows = rows.append(row)
            nat[] terms := []
            for row := rows[]
                bits := row_pattern(row, #var_list)
                nat term := 0
                for: i < #var_list
                    nat factor := .forest.leaf(var_list[i])
                    if bits[i] == "0"
                        factor = .forest.unary(factor)
                    term = if i == 0 then factor else .forest.binary("&", term, factor)
                terms = terms.append(term)
            nat root := if #terms == 0 then .forest.leaf("0") else terms[0]
            for: 1 <= i < #terms
                root = .forest.binary("|", root, terms[i])
            return .assign_definition(name, root)
        split_command := has_text(["RESTRICT", "COFACTOR", "MINDC", "EQUIV", "IMPLIES"], command)
        front := argument
        back := ""
        nat second_start := 0
        if split_command
            match argument.find(";")
                nat position
                    front = argument[:<position]
                    back = argument[position + 1:]
                    second_start = #command + 3 + position
                none
                    return error("missing ';'")
        nat root := try .parse_formula(front, #command + 2)
        other := root
        pair_command := has_text(["MINDC", "EQUIV", "IMPLIES"], command)
        if pair_command
            other = try .parse_formula(back, second_start)
        map<string, bool> assigned
        if command == "RESTRICT"
            assignments := words(back)
            if #assignments == 0
                return error("missing assignment")
            for word := assignments[]
                if #word != 3 or not variable_word(word[0]) or word[1] != "=" or (word[2] != "0" and word[2] != "1")
                    return error("bad assignment '" + word + "'")
                if assigned.has(word[0])
                    return error("duplicate variable " + word[0])
                .assigned.set(word[0], word[2] == "1")
            nat result := .forest.simplify(root, assigned)
            return ["restricted: " + forest.notation(result)]
        if command == "COFACTOR"
            parts := words(back)
            if #parts != 1 or not variable_word(parts[0])
                return error("bad variable")
            name := parts[0]
            .assigned.set(name, true)
            nat high := .forest.simplify(root, assigned)
            .assigned.set(name, false)
            nat low := .forest.simplify(root, assigned)
            nat difference := .forest.combine("^", high, low)
            return ["cofactor " + name + "=1: " + forest.notation(high), "cofactor " + name + "=0: " + forest.notation(low), "difference: " + forest.notation(difference)]
        string[] var_list := forest.variables(root)
        if pair_command
            for name := forest.variables(other)[]
                if not has_text(var_list, name)
                    var_list = var_list.append(name)
            var_list = var_list.sorted()
        table_commands := "TABLE MINTERMS MAXTERMS DNF CNF ANF SAT TAUT COUNT EQUIV IMPLIES PROPS KMAP BDD MINIMIZE MINDC MINPOS".split(" ")
        if has_text(table_commands, command) and #var_list >= 9
            return error("too many variables: {#var_list}")
        if command == "PRINT"
            return ["formula: " + forest.notation(root), "variables: " + (if #var_list == 0 then "none" else var_list.join(" ")), "size {forest.tree_size(root)} depth {forest.tree_depth(root)}"]
        if command == "NNF"
            nat result := .forest.nnf(root)
            return ["nnf: " + forest.notation(result)]
        if command == "DUAL"
            nat result := .forest.dual(root)
            return ["dual: " + forest.notation(result)]
        if command == "SIMPLIFY"
            nat result := .forest.simplify(root, assigned)
            return ["simplified: " + forest.notation(result)]
        if command == "CLAUSES" or command == "DP"
            .forest.reset_clauses()
            nat normal := .forest.nnf(root)
            string[] clauses := .forest.clauses_of(normal, var_list)
            if command == "CLAUSES"
                return ["clauses: " + products_text(order_patterns(clauses), var_list, true)]
            output := ["start: clauses {#clauses}"]
            string empty_clause := "-" * #var_list
            for: i < #var_list
                if #clauses == 0 or has_text(clauses, empty_clause)
                    break
                positive := [for clause := clauses[] if clause[i] == "1" then clause]
                negative := [for clause := clauses[] if clause[i] == "0" then clause]
                kept := [for clause := clauses[] if clause[i] == "-" then clause]
                map<string, bool> resolvents
                for a := positive[]
                    for b := negative[]
                        first := a[:<i] + "-" + a[i + 1:]
                        second := b[:<i] + "-" + b[i + 1:]
                        match merge_patterns(first, second)
                            string merged
                                .resolvents.set(merged, true)
                            none
                                void
                clauses = tidy_clauses(kept.concat(resolvents.keys()))
                output = output.append("eliminate " + var_list[i] + ": resolvents {resolvents.size()} clauses {#clauses}")
            return output.append(if has_text(clauses, empty_clause) then "result: unsatisfiable" else "result: satisfiable")
        bool[] values := forest.truth_values(root, var_list)
        bool[] others := if pair_command then forest.truth_values(other, var_list) else []
        on := [for row := (nat(0):<#values)[] if values[row] then row]
        off := [for row := (nat(0):<#values)[] if not values[row] then row]
        if command == "TABLE"
            output := [(if #var_list == 0 then "" else var_list.join(" ") + " ") + "| F"]
            for: row < #values
                bits := row_pattern(row, #var_list)
                cells := [for i := (nat(0):<#bits)[] then bits[i]]
                output = output.append((if #cells == 0 then "" else cells.join(" ") + " ") + "| " + (if values[row] then "1" else "0"))
            return output
        if command == "MINTERMS" or command == "MAXTERMS"
            rows := if command == "MINTERMS" then on else off
            numbers := [for row := rows[] then string(row)]
            return [(if command == "MINTERMS" then "minterms: " else "maxterms: ") + (if #numbers == 0 then "none" else numbers.join(" "))]
        if command == "DNF" or command == "CNF"
            clause := command == "CNF"
            rows := if clause then off else on
            patterns := [for row := rows[] then (if clause then swap_pattern(row_pattern(row, #var_list)) else row_pattern(row, #var_list))]
            return [(if clause then "cnf: " else "dnf: ") + products_text(patterns, var_list, clause)]
        if command == "SAT"
            return [if #on == 0 then "unsatisfiable" else "satisfiable: " + assignment_text(on[0], var_list)]
        if command == "TAUT"
            return [if #off == 0 then "tautology" else "not a tautology: " + assignment_text(off[0], var_list)]
        if command == "COUNT"
            return ["models: {#on} of {#values}"]
        if command == "EQUIV" or command == "IMPLIES"
            for: row < #values
                if command == "EQUIV" and values[row] != others[row]
                    return ["not equivalent: " + assignment_text(row, var_list) + " f=" + (if values[row] then "1" else "0") + " g=" + (if others[row] then "1" else "0")]
                if command == "IMPLIES" and values[row] and not others[row]
                    return ["does not imply: " + assignment_text(row, var_list)]
            return [if command == "EQUIV" then "equivalent" else "implies"]
        if command == "KMAP"
            if #var_list < 2 or #var_list > 4
                return error("kmap needs 2 to 4 variables")
            p := #var_list / 2
            q := #var_list - p
            label := var_list[:<p].join("") + "\" + var_list[p:].join("")
            columns := [for i := (0:<nat(power_two(q)))[] then row_pattern(xor_numbers(i, i / 2), q)]
            output := [label + " " + columns.join(" ")]
            for: i < power_two(p)
                gray := xor_numbers(i, i / 2)
                string row := row_pattern(gray, p) + " " * (#label - p)
                for: j < #columns
                    column := xor_numbers(j, j / 2)
                    row += " " * q + (if values[gray * power_two(q) + column] then "1" else "0")
                output = output.append(row)
            return output
        if command == "BDD"
            diagram := Diagram()
            result := .diagram.build(values)
            nat[] paths := [0, 1]
            output := ["nodes: {#diagram.nodes}"]
            for: i < #diagram.nodes
                node := diagram.nodes[i]
                paths = paths.append(paths[node.low] + paths[node.high])
                output = output.append("{i + 2} = ite(" + var_list[node.level] + ", {node.high}, {node.low})")
            return output.concat(["root: {result}", "paths: {paths[result]}"])
        coefficients := anf_coefficients(values, #var_list)
        if command == "ANF"
            string[] patterns := []
            for: degree <= #var_list
                string[] selected := []
                for: row < #coefficients
                    if coefficients[row] and bit_count(row) == degree
                        selected = selected.append(omit_zeros(row_pattern(row, #var_list)))
                patterns = patterns.concat(order_patterns(selected))
            terms := [for pattern := patterns[] then pattern_text(pattern, var_list)]
            return ["anf: " + (if #terms == 0 then "0" else terms.join(" ^ "))]
        if command == "PROPS"
            string[] depends := []
            monotone := true
            for: i < #var_list
                bit := power_two(#var_list - i - 1)
                changes := false
                for: row < #values
                    flipped := if row / bit % 2 == 0 then row + bit else row - bit
                    if values[row] != values[flipped]
                        changes = true
                    if row / bit % 2 == 0 and values[row] and not values[row + bit]
                        monotone = false
                if changes
                    depends = depends.append(var_list[i])
            self_dual := true
            linear := true
            symmetric := true
            for: row < #values
                if values[row] == values[#values - row - 1]
                    self_dual = false
                if coefficients[row] and bit_count(row) > 1
                    linear = false
                if values[row] != values[power_two(bit_count(row)) - 1]
                    symmetric = false
            return ["depends: " + (if #depends == 0 then "none" else depends.join(" ")), "zero-preserving: " + yes_no(not values[0]), "one-preserving: " + yes_no(values[-1]), "self-dual: " + yes_no(self_dual), "monotone: " + yes_no(monotone), "linear: " + yes_no(linear), "symmetric: " + yes_no(symmetric)]
        nat[] dc := []
        if command == "MINDC"
            dc = [for row := (nat(0):<#others)[] if others[row] then row]
            on = [for row := on[] if not others[row] then row]
        product := command == "MINPOS"
        result := minimize(if product then off else on, dc, #var_list, product)
        shown := if product then order_patterns([for pattern := result.cover[] then swap_pattern(pattern)]) else result.cover
        nat total_literals := 0
        for pattern := result.cover[]
            total_literals += literal_count(pattern)
        if product
            return ["minimal: " + products_text(shown, var_list, true), "clauses {#result.cover} literals {total_literals}"]
        string[] output := []
        for: i < #result.stages
            output = output.append("stage {i}: implicants {result.stages[i].implicants} primes {result.stages[i].primes}")
        primes := [for pattern := result.targets[] then pattern_text(pattern, var_list)]
        essential := [for pattern := result.essential[] then pattern_text(pattern, var_list)]
        return output.concat(["primes: " + (if #primes == 0 then "none" else primes.join(", ")), "essential: " + (if #essential == 0 then "none" else essential.join(", ")), "minimal: " + products_text(shown, var_list), "terms {#result.cover} literals {total_literals}"])

void read_commands()
    line := ""
    scan(&line)
    count := nat(line)
    workbench := Workbench()
    for: i < count
        scan(&line)
        match .workbench.run_command(line)
            string[] output
                for text := output[]
                    emit(text)
            error failure
                emit("error: " + failure.message)

read_commands()
